display_long_description:
Take on the Wild West in Gunslinger Shooting VR, a focused VR shooting game. Grab your revolver or pistol and put your aim to the test in fast, skill-based shooting challenges.
The game is all about timing, precision, and reflexes. Each challenge is short and fun, giving you a clear goal: hit your targets, get better, and see how fast you can react.
It’s built to feel smooth and comfortable on Meta Quest. Controls are easy, movement is simple, and the focus is always on shooting that feels satisfying.

What You’ll Do
•	Shoot using classic Western firearms like revolvers and pistols
•	Take on quick, skill-based shooting challenges
•	Improve your aim, timing, and reflexes
•	Play standing or seated

 Built for VR
•	Optimized for Meta Quest
•	Clear, easy-to-read Western-style arenas
•	Comfortable for short or long play sessions
Sharpen your aim, master your reflexes, and take on every challenge the Wild West throws at you.

Download Gunslinger Shooting VR and start shooting today.
